# Dry Bulk Shipping

## Bi-Weekly Industry Report

### June 9, 2026

- **Capesize Rates Drop to One-Month lows as Fixing Frenzy Stalls -** Following an **exceptionally strong performance** in May, during which Capesize spot rates reached a 15-year seasonal high, the market has begun to soften, with spot rates subsequently dropping to one-month lows. Due to historically weak seasonal trends in June, this **downward trajectory is anticipated to persist** in the near term; however, freight futures continue to indicate a robust third quarter despite recent market volatility. The **Pacific** spot market currently represents the **weakest** **segment** as the fiscal year-end push approaches its conclusion this month (some Australian miners report on a June 30 Fiscal Year basis).
